known_limitations.explanation: Spanish changes y to e before a following /i/ sound (e.g. Investigador, Historiador), but not before a /je/ glide (e.g. Hierro). The position-only ICU select cannot inspect tail pronunciation. The submitted y is the correct default and is not a mistranslation or repairable by substituting e unconditionally. This is a documented formatter/caller limitation, not an unresolved BLOCKER/MAJOR on this single-key translation audit. For arbitrary names, Coder y Investigador is nonstandard; the native wording is Coder e Investigador. A general solution needs phonetic-aware list handling/caller support, not a guessed catalogue-only change.
known_limitations.future_fix: A future list-join key must take {tail}, with phonetic-aware caller/formatter support to choose y/e; position alone cannot inspect the following i-sound.
